items.item_text: ELT Development and Snowflake Data Engineering: Develops and maintains scalable, reusable, and secure ELT pipelines using dbt and other tools. Performs data ingestions, transformation, and load operations in Snowflake. Monitors and troubleshoots data workflows to ensure performance, reliability, data integrity, and alignment with medallion architecture. Models data using dbt for transformation following SDLC best practices, exercising modularity and reusability principles in model code. Ensures data models are in alignment with medallion architecture and enterprise dimensional modeling concepts. Implements best practices and data governance standards in ELT processes.

Data Integration and Reverse ETL: Develops and supports data activations between on-premises and cloud-based data platforms to destination applications. Ensures that data is delivered accurately and timely to downstream platforms supporting institutional operations. Develops and maintains data models, schema designs, and data dictionaries for shared data models and integrations. Documents design, mappings, and data flow diagrams for knowledge sharing and compliance purposes.

Cross-functional Collaboration: Partners with DBAs for schema design, indexing, and database performance optimization. Collaborates with Analytics Engineers to prepare analysis-ready data models. Works with BI Analysts to ensure data availability for dashboards and operational reporting. Coordinates with external partners and functional units.

Data Privacy and Security: Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations (e.g. FERPA, IS3) by developing and enforcing data protection policies. Collaborate with legal and compliance teams to manage data access permissions, masking, and encryption. Administer on-premises and cloud-based data security, role-based access control (RBAC), managing load operations, performance, computing and storage management, data replication and data sharing.

Data Governance and Documentation: Supports data quality checks, metadata capture, and data catalog contributions. Develops and maintains dbt project yaml files that support semantic layer and semantic models. Documents data pipelines, mappings, and workflow logic using tools such as GitHub, JIRA, and Confluence. Participates in campuswide data governance and stewardship efforts.

Platform Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Explores new technologies, proposes automation opportunities, AI-enabled development, and contributes to architectural decisions to modernize the university's data ecosystems.
